english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for offering to do something or offering information without being prompted.
This is the all-purpose choice for volunteering to do something or putting forward an idea, opinion, or suggestion.

examples.english: No one wants to do it this time, so Ming will volunteer to help.
examples.traditional: 今次冇人肯做，阿明就主動提出幫手。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 mou5 jan4 hang2 zou6 aa3 ming4 zau6 zyu2 dung6 tai4 ceot1 bong1 sau2

examples.english: I offer to look over the contract for you.
examples.traditional: 我主動提出幫你睇份合約。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zyu2 dung6 tai4 ceot1 bong1 nei5 tai2 fan6 hap6 joek3
